newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Turner names executive vice-president.
newsitem.headline: Turner names executive vice-president.

text.p: Turner Broadcasting System Inc said on Tuesday it had named Daniel Stone as executive vice-president for international operations and business development.

Stone, to be based in New York, will be responsible for overall business development and strategic planning in the international arena, such as joint ventures, business alliances, partnerships and new business development, Turner said in a statement issued in Hong Kong.
It did not say when the new appointment would take effect.
Stone joined Turner in 1994 as senior vice-president for client and market development, it said.
